exposure: Women who received CSE analgesia in labor vs. those who did not
outcome: Blood loss volume during vaginal delivery
Umbilical arterial blood gas pH < 7.15 and <7.10
finding: CSE analgesia during labor was associated with an increased risk of several adverse obstetric and neonatal outcomes, including oxytocin augmentation, prolonged labor, instrumental delivery, increased blood loss, meconium-stained amniotic fluid, and lower Apgar scores at 1 minute.
